name: Level-0
Description: A large, repetitive liminal environment dominated by yellow rooms and corridors. The level can appear empty while still creating a strong sense of unease.

name: Cave
Description: A dark underground environment consisting primarily of caves and enclosed passages. Limited visibility makes navigation difficult.

name: Garage
Description: A large industrial environment resembling an abandoned garage or electrical facility. The area contains dark spaces and dangerous infrastructure.

name: Fun
Description: A deceptively cheerful environment based around parties, childhood imagery and colorful decorations. The friendly appearance hides serious dangers.

name: Sewers
Description: A network of dark and humid tunnels containing stagnant water, narrow passages and poor visibility.

name: House
Description: A residential-looking environment that initially appears safe and familiar. The ordinary appearance can hide unexpected dangers.

name: Hotels
Description: A seemingly endless hotel environment containing corridors, rooms and other hospitality areas. Its size and isolation make navigation difficult.

name: Circus
Description: A strange circus-themed environment combining entertainment imagery with dark and surreal elements. Powerful entities may inhabit the area.
